# Example themes

Copy a folder into `.themes` in your home folder (`/home/tos/.themes/NAME`), then pick it in System Settings > Appearance.

```
NAME/theme.conf        dark=1            1 dark, 0 light
                       accent=88C0D0     RRGGBB
                       wallpaper=2       0 Dusk, 1 Ocean, 2 Graphite, or a picture's file name inside the folder
                       icons=classic     whitesur, classic, or the name of a folder of pictures inside this one
NAME/icons/*.png       a picture replaces the icon of the same name (icon48_files.png, icon20_files.png, doc64_folder.png ...)
```

- **Nord**: dark, teal accent, Graphite wallpaper, the Classic icons.
- **Sunset**: light, coral accent, Ocean wallpaper, its own icons for Files, Terminal, Notepad and Calculator.
